faq.a1: Ronaq Store par aap Pakistan bhar ki muqami dukano se phones aur accessories dekh saktay hain, shehar chunein, aur direct WhatsApp par rabta karein — baghair account banaye.
faq.a2: Jee haan. Sirf wo dukanein jo review pass karein aur online rahein, public directory mein aati hain.
faq.a3: Product ya dukan ka page kholein, aur 'Order on WhatsApp' se dukandar ko direct message karein qeemat aur stock ke baray mein.
